title: $φ^6$ at $6$ (and some $8$) loops in $3d$
summary: We recalculate the contributions of individual six loop graphs to the $β$-function for a three dimensional scalar theory with an arbitrary sextic scalar potential. Previously this was calculated by Hager who specialised to a theory with maximal $O(N)$ symmetry. Our results differ in some contributions to the overall $β$-function but agree with a recent calculation \cite{Kompaniets2}. At large $N$ three eight loop diagrams which are relevant are calculated.
